recommendation: Keep the commit. Future publication checks should continue scanning both definitions and examples packages for FHIR canonical resources without root version, while preserving the Jira exclusion for UTG and externally maintained artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-19471 requested release/version stamping for FHIR-defined conformance resources such as StructureDefinitions, ValueSets, and OperationDefinitions; the Published/Persuasive resolution applied that expectation to R4 and later FHIR-managed artifacts while excluding UTG and other external artifacts.
initial_application: Upstream commit e3380a32e009716cc82a1036faa0d5f91e5e37da implemented the original change in the historical Java publication tooling, and the current definitions package scan confirms generated definitions are already stamped.
additional_context: The current source no longer contains the historical Java publisher implementation. A current build scan showed remaining omissions only in a bounded set of source-owned FHIR-core example conformance resources. DeviceDefinition examples were not treated as conformance-resource release-version targets, the SDC Questionnaire example was left to its external IG, and a generated example-composition StructureDefinition from build.fhir.org is no longer present in current source after later profile cleanup.
reconciliation: The commit adds root version value 6.0.0-ballot4 to 22 source-owned FHIR-core conformance example XML files so their published examples expose the current release version.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue asking for FHIR-defined conformance resources to expose their release in version, with tooling stamping for R4 and later FHIR-managed artifacts and external artifacts excluded.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes both the required version-stamping behavior and the explicit exclusion for UTG or other externally maintained artifacts.

evidence_items.summary: Historical GF#19471 commit added version stamping and validation to the old Java publication tooling for generated conformance resources.
evidence_items.learned: The original application was through publisher/tooling behavior, explaining why generated definitions are already stamped today.

evidence_items.command: curl -fsSL https://build.fhir.org/definitions.json.zip; scan JSON resources with url starting http://hl7.org/fhir for missing version
evidence_items.summary: The definitions package scan found 3030 FHIR-canonical conformance resources and zero missing version values.
evidence_items.learned: Current generated definitions already satisfy FHIR-19471, so the remaining problem was not in the definitions package.

evidence_items.learned: This identifies a bounded current-build gap appropriate for source-owned example XML edits.
